title: Convert selected supplier quote to Purchase Order
description: Close the audited PurchaseQuote downstream gap: convert a selected supplier comparison row into the existing EF Purchase Order workflow, preserving source traceability and duplicate protection. Do not change production schema or deploy.
acceptance_criteria: A selected PurchaseQuote supplier row exposes a user-visible create/prefill Purchase Order action.
Supplier, customer/order ownership, currency, tax/price, delivery and product detail values are mapped deterministically and revalidated server-side.
Only an eligible selected supplier quote can convert; invalid/unselected rows are rejected with a clear message.
Repeated conversion is idempotent or guarded against duplicate Purchase Orders.
Unit/integration tests cover mapping, eligibility and duplicate protection; safe validation passes.
Browser/UI acceptance is recorded as deferred during development according to project policy.

scenarios: Convert an eligible selected supplier quote to a Purchase Order and verify mapped values.
Repeat conversion and verify duplicate prevention.

human_gate.reason: Application-code workflow using existing entities; no production database/deployment action.
